variables.input:
fetch dt.entity.service
//| filter isNotNull(belongs_to[dt.entity.cloud_application_namespace])
| fields id, Service = entity.name, namespace = belongs_to[dt.entity.cloud_application_namespace], tags
| expand namespace
| fieldsAdd namespace = entityName(namespace, type:"dt.entity.cloud_application_namespace")
//| filter in(namespace, "unguard")
| filterOut matchesPhrase(Service, "background threads") or
             matchesPhrase(Service, "Health")
| expand tags
| filter contains(tags,"[Environment]DT_RELEASE_PRODUCT:easytravel")
| summarize distinctServices = collectDistinct(Service)
| expand distinctServices
| sort distinctServices asc

| fields services = arrayRemoveNulls(array("ALL", distinctServices))

13.title: Throughput (request/minute)
13.query:
timeseries count = sum(dt.service.request.count, rate: 1m), by: { dt.entity.service }, filter: {
           in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), tag([Environment]DT_RELEASE_PRODUCT:easytravel)"))) 
           and
           ((if($criticalServices != "ALL", in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), entityName.equals(\"",$criticalServices,"\")"))))) 
           or
           (if($criticalServices == "ALL", isNotNull(dt.entity.service))))
           }

19.content:
### 🚦 Production: SLOs of ALL Critical Services
#### [GoTo: SLO management view](https://wkf10640.apps.dynatrace.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.settings/settings/dynatrace.service.level.objectives)

20.query:
timeseries {latency_p50 = median(dt.service.request.response_time),
           latency_p90 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 90),
           Throughput = sum(dt.service.request.count), 
           errors = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count)},
           by:{dt.entity.service},
           filter: {
           //in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(service), toRelationship.isNamespaceOfService(type(CLOUD_APPLICATION_NAMESPACE), entityName.equals(\"",$K8sNamespace,"\"))"))) 
           in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), tag([Environment]DT_RELEASE_PRODUCT:easytravel)"))) 
           and
           ((if($criticalServices != "ALL", in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), entityName.equals(\"",$criticalServices,"\")"))))) 
           or
           (if($criticalServices == "ALL", isNotNull(dt.entity.service))))
           }

| fieldsAdd Service = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| fieldsAdd Latency_p50 = arrayAvg(latency_p50),
            Latency_p90 = arrayAvg(latency_p90),
            Throughput = arraySum(Throughput), 
            Errors = arraySum(errors),
            dt.entity.service
| fieldsAdd Availability = 100 - (Errors/Throughput) *100


| fields Service,
         Status = if(Availability < 98.00 , "🔴 Unhealthy ",  else: "✅ Healthy"),
         StatusSort = if(Availability < 98.00, 0, else: 1),
         Availability,
         Throughput,
         Errors,
         Latency_p50,
         Latency_p90,
         dt.entity.service
| sort StatusSort asc
| fieldsRemove StatusSort
| filterOut matchesPhrase(Service, "background threads") or
            matchesPhrase(Service, "Health")

41.title: Performance SLOs (<500ms)
41.query:
timeseries total=avg(dt.service.request.response_time), default:0
, by: { dt.entity.service }
  ,filter: {
           in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), tag([Environment]DT_RELEASE_PRODUCT:easytravel)"))) 
           and
           ((if($criticalServices != "ALL", in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), entityName.equals(\"",$criticalServices,"\")"))))) 
           or
           (if($criticalServices == "ALL", isNotNull(dt.entity.service))))}

| fieldsAdd entityName = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| fieldsAdd high=iCollectArray(if(total[]> (1000 * 500), total[]))
| fieldsAdd low=iCollectArray(if(total[]<= (1000 * 500), total[]))
| fieldsAdd highRespTimes=iCollectArray(if(isNull(high[]),0,else:1))
| fieldsAdd lowRespTimes=iCollectArray(if(isNull(low[]),0,else:1))
| fieldsAdd slo_target = 90
| fieldsAdd sli=100*(lowRespTimes[]/(lowRespTimes[]+highRespTimes[]))
| fieldsAdd slo_status = arrayAvg(sli)
| fieldsKeep dt.entity.service,entityName, slo_target, slo_status

44.title: Combined SLO table
44.query:
timeseries { totalResp=avg(dt.service.request.response_time), default:0,
              totalReq=sum(dt.service.request.count) ,failures=sum(dt.service.request.failure_count) }
  , by: { dt.entity.service }
  ,filter: {
           in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), tag([Environment]DT_RELEASE_PRODUCT:easytravel)"))) 
           and
           ((if($criticalServices != "ALL", in(dt.entity.service, classicEntitySelector(concat("type(SERVICE), entityName.equals(\"",$criticalServices,"\")"))))) 
           or
           (if($criticalServices == "ALL", isNotNull(dt.entity.service))))}


| fieldsAdd sliAvail=(((totalReq[]-failures[])/totalReq[])*(100))
| fieldsAdd entityName(dt.entity.service)
| fieldsRemove totalReq, failures
| fieldsAdd availability_target = 99
| fieldsAdd slo_status_avail = arrayAvg(sliAvail)

| fieldsAdd high=iCollectArray(if(totalResp[]> (1000 * 500), totalResp[]))
| fieldsAdd low=iCollectArray(if(totalResp[]<= (1000 * 500), totalResp[]))
| fieldsAdd highRespTimes=iCollectArray(if(isNull(high[]),0,else:1))
| fieldsAdd lowRespTimes=iCollectArray(if(isNull(low[]),0,else:1))
| fieldsAdd sliResp=100*(lowRespTimes[]/(lowRespTimes[]+highRespTimes[]))
| fieldsAdd performance_target = 90
| fieldsAdd slo_status_perf = arrayAvg(sliResp)

| fieldsKeep dt.entity.service,dt.entity.service.name, availability_target, slo_status_avail,performance_target, slo_status_perf
